name: list_connected_workspaces
title: List connected Edict IQ workspaces
description: Lists only the organizations and workspaces available to this authenticated Edict IQ connection. Workspace-specific operations require explicit organization_id and workspace_id identifiers; targets are not inferred.

name: search_regulatory_changes
title: Search regulatory changes
description: Search Edict IQ's approved source-backed regulatory change layer by business question. Returns concise change, impact and relevance fields, not raw source-registry or acquisition data.

name: get_regulatory_change
title: Get regulatory change
description: Retrieve one approved Edict IQ regulatory change with source identity, what changed and impact context. Machine output intentionally withholds raw acquisition metadata and direct source URLs.

name: get_regulatory_evidence
title: Get verified regulatory evidence
description: Retrieve bounded verified citation excerpts and legal-location metadata for one approved Edict IQ event. Direct source URLs, hashes, parser details and acquisition metadata are excluded.

name: list_workspace_monitors
title: List workspace monitors
description: List saved target monitors and view monitors in the explicitly selected, authorized Edict IQ workspace. Includes status and delivery cadence. No creation or analysis credits.

name: list_workspace_impacts
title: List workspace impacts
description: List organization-specific impact assessments from the workspace bound to this credential. Private context snapshots, user identifiers and raw evidence payloads are excluded.

name: get_workspace_impact
title: Get workspace impact decision chain
description: Retrieve one workspace impact assessment with human-reviewed applicability, obligation changes, control and policy impacts, evidence requests and compliance gaps. Raw context and evidence JSON stay private.

name: list_workspace_open_work
title: List open regulatory work
description: List unresolved compliance gaps and evidence requests in the credential-bound workspace so an AI client can answer what still needs attention without receiving the underlying private corpus.

name: create_target_monitor
title: Create target monitor in Edict IQ
description: Creates one monitored target in an explicitly selected Edict IQ workspace on explicit user request. This state-changing operation requires monitor.write consent and a stable idempotency_key UUID. Plan limits and audit records apply. No analysis credits are consumed.

idempotency_key.description: One stable UUID per user-requested creation. Reuse it on retries.

annotations.title: Create target monitor in Edict IQ

name: prepare_upload_handoff
title: Get upload link
description: Returns a link to the selected Edict IQ workspace upload page for a document check, portfolio import, or legal entity import. This tool does not upload, import, analyze, or modify files. The user opens the link and selects files directly in Edict IQ. Attachments, file contents, public file URLs, access tokens, and upload credentials are not accepted by this tool. Imports require user review. Document analysis costs 1 credit per page only after explicit confirmation in Edict IQ.

name: get_workspace_inventory
title: Get a bounded Edict IQ entity and portfolio overview
description: Read bounded counts and a small overview of legal entities and portfolio positions from a deliberately selected workspace. Requires a separately approved inventory.read OAuth permission. Never returns source files, account numbers, market values, private notes, raw context, or bulk positions.

annotations.title: Get a bounded Edict IQ entity and portfolio overview

name: list_document_checks
title: Check the status of your Edict IQ document analyses
description: List at most ten document-check jobs started by the connected user in the selected Edict IQ workspace. This tool does not read document content, file paths or model results; it reports completion and credited page cost only. Requires separate analysis.read OAuth permission.

annotations.title: Check the status of your Edict IQ document analyses
